models_evaluated: six popular AI chatbots (free and paywall versions)

links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot responses versus AMA recommended 6th grade
links.effect: Mean readability 9.2 grades (95% CI 8.8-9.6), high-school level, not concordant with AMA recommendation (≤ 6th grade).
links.quote: The readability was high-school-level (mean [95% CI]: 9.2 [8.8-9.6] grades), not concordant with the American Medical Association recommendation (≤ 6th grade).

links.outcome: Readability and actionability of chatbot cancer responses in Spanish
links.effect: Readability was high-school level (9.2 grades) and actionability low (35.6%, 95% CI 30.8%-40.3%).
links.quote: The quality of overall AI chatbot responses was good (mean [95% CI]: 3.5 [3.4-3.6] points), while the actionability was low (mean [95% CI]: 35.6% [30.8%-40.3%]).

screen.reason: Evaluated the quality, actionability, and readability of six AI chatbots answering common Spanish-language cancer questions without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
